callouts.phrase: the mountain of God, even to Horeb
callouts.verse: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.

callouts.phrase: a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush
callouts.verse: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

callouts.phrase: put off thy shoes from off thy feet
callouts.verse: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
